clauses.quote: 日犯嵗君如甲日尅戊年為偏財
四柱元有庚申金或大運中亦有将甲木制伏純粹不能尅戊土為有救
如大運并四柱中有一癸字與戊相合為有情
若二字俱全其年凶反為吉有一字者㐫半二字俱無㓙莫能觧
柱中無庚辛巳酉丑金局制木丙丁火局焚木者太凶
若日干是天月徳太嵗是用神則無咎而反有獲
戊與癸何名為無情之合

adjudicatedLocalReading.entry: 本命日干甲且所选流年干戊；只读对应 scope.year，不借同盘其它流年。
adjudicatedLocalReading.natalGengshenBranch: L1082 says 四柱元有庚申金 or the separate pure-suppression Dayun path. A complete natal same-pillar 庚申 satisfies this literal natal branch; the phrase 制伏纯粹不能尅戊土 modifies the Dayun branch and is not imported as a force threshold for the natal branch.
adjudicatedLocalReading.samePillar: 庚 and 申 must be the Gan and Zhi of the same natal pillar. Cross-pillar 庚/申 cannot be combined into 庚申.
adjudicatedLocalReading.localGuiWuBranch: Within the selected 甲日戊年 example, exactly one visible 癸 stem across the complete natal four Gan and that year's effective Dayun Gan satisfies the named local clause. Zero visible 癸 disproves only this named branch. More than one visible 癸 is 信息不足 because the line's 一癸 scope and same-book pairing conflicts are not resolved.
adjudicatedLocalReading.dayunPureSuppression: No executable threshold is adopted. Without a proven natal 庚申 branch, this alternative stays 信息不足 even when the selected Dayun is known; visible 庚/辛, hidden stems, or element counts do not prove or disprove 纯粹制伏.
adjudicatedLocalReading.laterConditions: L1086, L1087, and L9697 remain outside this local step; no L1082 ladder output is promoted to a full SANMINGTONGH-010 or six-topic verdict.

inputFactContract.conflictPolicy: Equal duplicates at the same key/scope collapse to one value. Distinct values at a required scope are a conflict and produce 信息不足. Missing or invalid required values produce 信息不足. Other years and unscoped lifetime Dayun entries cannot fill the selected-year scope.
inputFactContract.multiGuiPolicy: Exactly one visible 癸 satisfies the local named branch; zero disproves only that branch; two or more remain 信息不足.
inputFactContract.crossPillarPolicy: A natal gan=庚 in one pillar and zhi=申 in a different pillar do not satisfy the Geng-Shen branch.
inputFactContract.notApplicablePolicy: Known natal day Gan other than 甲 or known selected-year Gan other than 戊 makes this source example 不适用; an entry conflict or missing selected-year input is 信息不足.
